name: Mage Fire
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level sorcerer/wizard 5

DESCRIPTION

As flame blade, but it deals 1d4 damage per 3 levels, and as a standard action you can cast a touch spell and deliver it with an attack by the mage fire (dealing fire damage normally). If you miss this attack, the touch spell is lost.
